issues.title: The go Select's third option (Cancel) is NOT rendered whenever an option label wraps - which is the normal case: any slug longer than 34 chars at ANY width, the 4-char fixture slug below 102 columns, and with an M-force override no option renders at all up to ~70x14
issues.proposed_solution: AGENT-FIXABLE. Keep every option label to ONE line at the modal width and move the exact command out of the labels: e.g. huh.NewOption("Launch", goLaunchFull), huh.NewOption("Launch --fast  (token-lean gogo-fast pipeline)", goLaunchFast), huh.NewOption("Cancel", goLaunchCancel), with the effective command shown live in the Select's title via .Title(initial).TitleFunc(fn, &m.binding.launchMode) - huh re-evaluates TitleFunc when the bound value's hash changes (the plan's measured probe P3), and fn must still build the string through launch.SetFastParam(intent.Command, mode == goLaunchFast) so the ONE-producer property of FR4 (shown == launched) is preserved. Do NOT try to fix it with Select.Height(): Group.WithHeight re-applies field.WithHeight on every WindowSizeMsg (huh@v1.0.0/group.go:131-137), so an explicit height is overwritten on the next resize. Then close the test gap: parameterise the launch-modal tests over a realistic slug (this feature's own 36-char slug) and add 100x24 / 80x24 to the size matrix, asserting all three option labels appear in m.View() (and, for the M-force arm, that at least one launch option renders at 60x12).
issues.fix_summary: One-line option labels (Launch / Launch --fast (token-lean gogo-fast) / Cancel); the exact command moved to the TITLE, re-evaluated live via TitleFunc bound to launchMode through the same SetFastParam producer doLaunch applies (FR4 preserved). The FORCING description is compressed to the cap + blocking slugs (forcingNote) so the options keep their rows at 60x12. Test gap closed: TestGoSelectShowsAllThreeOptions (36-char slug over 200x40/120x30/100x24/80x24) + TestForcedGoSelectShowsALaunchOptionAtTheModalMinimum (60x12, FORCING present, all options render); the seeds test now asserts the live title flip.

issues.title: The modal also wraps the SHIP (d) and ACCEPT confirms, not just the /gogo:go confirm - D2=B was resolved as 'the launch confirm ONLY for now'
issues.description:
cli/internal/tui/move.go:454 seeds binding = &formBinding{confirm: true, launchSite: true} for EVERY intent that reaches startFormOverriding, and move.go:500 calls enterLaunchModal unconditionally - so the marker modalLaunchConfirm() (move.go:534) reads true for the /gogo:done ship confirm (including the merged-ship release-name Input) and for the /gogo:accept confirm as well as the go Select. Verified by driving `d` on a ready card at 200x40: modalLaunchConfirm()=true, the view carries the box border and the dimmed board behind it. That is defensible under the 'one site' reading of D2=B (move.go:464 is a single form site serving m/M/d) and it is what the as-built chart shows (charts/flow.mmd routes 'ship / accept' through enterLaunchModal), but it contradicts the strict reading of the accepted fork ('the launch confirm ONLY for now; the other 15 form sites keep the full-screen takeover') and of plan.md FR6 ('a ship, an accept ... are byte-for-byte today's'). docs/cli-contract.md's 0.36.0 note lists what stays full-screen (delete, kill, pickers, config/plans-tab forms, the P plan-session confirm) and silently omits ship/accept, so a reader has to infer it. The result is also an inconsistency the user may not expect: `d` is a modal but `P` (also a launch confirm, of /gogo:plan) is a full-screen takeover.

ROUND-2 VERIFICATION: option (a) landed as claimed. docs/cli-contract.md:388-393 now states the scope out loud - 'The modal's scope is the ONE launch-confirm form site serving m/M/d: the ship (d) and accept confirms share it and render as modals too (incl. the merged-ship release-name input). Every other cockpit form (delete, kill, the pickers, config/plans-tab forms, and the P plan-session confirm - a launch confirm at a different site) keeps the full-screen takeover.' The site-scope reading is logged in adjustments.md under '2026-08-02 - review round 1, REV-002 scope clarification' with the reason (m/M/d consistency beats d/P consistency). No behaviour change was needed or made. Status -> verified. (One consequence of keeping the ship confirm in the modal is now filed as REV-006: the merged-ship Launch/Cancel row is clipped at 60x12-14.)
issues.proposed_solution: AGENT-FIXABLE, two one-line options - pick one and make the docs say it out loud. (a) KEEP the current scope (recommended: `d` is a launch confirm and consistency between m/M/d is better than between d and P) and add a clause to docs/cli-contract.md's 0.36.0 bullet, e.g. 'the ship (d) and accept confirms share this site and render as modals too; the P plan-session confirm does not'. (b) NARROW it to the go confirm by seeding launchSite only for a go intent (`launchSite: intent.Action == launch.ActionGo`) and dropping the 'merged ship' arm from TestModalNeverExceedsTheTerminal, adding instead an assertion that the ship confirm renders the full-screen form byte-for-byte.
issues.fix_summary: Option (a) kept per the reviewer recommendation: the modal scope is the ONE m/M/d launch-confirm site (ship + accept confirms render as modals too; P stays full-screen). Said out loud in docs/cli-contract.md 0.36.0 note and logged in adjustments.md.

issues.title: The CONFIRM-DEFAULT structural guard no longer pins the go confirm's real default - binding.confirm is now vestigial state on that form
issues.description:
For the go Select, launchConfirmed() (cli/internal/tui/model.go:157-165) branches on launchMode and never reads binding.confirm, so the `confirm: true` seeded at move.go:454 is dead state on that path. The structural guard TestConfirmDefaultsAreAlwaysExplicit (confirm_default_test.go:172-197) still greps startFormOverriding for `&formBinding{confirm: true,` and still passes - but it now certifies a field the widget does not consult, while the go confirm's ACTUAL default (m.binding.launchMode = goLaunchFull / goLaunchFast, move.go:472-475) is structurally unguarded: seeding goLaunchCancel there would leave the guard green. move.go:444-445 asserts the convention holds 'in its D1=B shape', but nothing structural enforces that claim. The behaviour itself is still pinned twice (TestConfirmDefaultForwardMovesSubmitOnEnter's 'board m launches' case and the new TestBareEnterStillLaunchesOnce, both driving a bare Enter through the real huh lifecycle and asserting fired-exactly-once), which is why this is minor and not major - but it is the 'a guard that looks like a check and isn't' shape coding-rules.md TEST-006 and code-review-standards.md #11 tell this repo to close.

ROUND-2 VERIFICATION: confirm_default_test.go:197-216 now scans startFormOverriding for `m.binding.launchMode = goLaunchFull` (required) and `m.binding.launchMode = goLaunchCancel` (forbidden), each with a failure message quoting the convention. MUTATION-CHECKED on a scratch copy of the tree (the source-scan reads move.go from disk at runtime, so a -overlay mutation does not reach it): flipping the seed to goLaunchCancel fires BOTH assertions - 'does not seed the go Select's launchMode to goLaunchFull' and 'seeds the go Select's launchMode to goLaunchCancel'. The guard now bites on the field launchConfirmed actually reads. `confirm: true` is deliberately kept (still the real discriminator for the ship/accept arm, and still pinned by the original assertion). Status -> verified.
issues.proposed_solution: AGENT-FIXABLE. Extend TestConfirmDefaultsAreAlwaysExplicit to know the Select shape: for startFormOverriding, additionally require the source to seed a NON-cancel launchMode (assert the body contains `m.binding.launchMode = goLaunchFull` and does NOT contain `m.binding.launchMode = goLaunchCancel`), with the same failure message quoting the convention. Optionally drop the now-unread `confirm: true` from the go arm - but only together with that new assertion, so the guard keeps biting on the field that actually decides.
issues.fix_summary: TestConfirmDefaultsAreAlwaysExplicit extended: startFormOverriding must seed m.binding.launchMode = goLaunchFull and must NOT seed goLaunchCancel - the guard now bites on the field launchConfirmed actually reads. confirm: true seeding kept (still real for the ship/accept arm).

issues.title: Four in-code comments still name the renamed field `pickerOrigin` after the D4=A rename - two of them in files this change edited
issues.description:
D4=A replaced pickerOrigin with formOrigin and the code references were all converted, but the prose was not: cli/internal/tui/session_ops_test.go:4 ('the pickerOrigin cancel fix') and :248 ('want the board (pickerOrigin fix)'), cli/internal/tui/card_test.go:345 ('The BOARD-origin picker (pickerOrigin=modeBoard)'), and cli/internal/tui/sessions_panel_test.go:206 ('the plan: pickerOrigin'). session_ops_test.go and card_test.go are files this diff already touched - the assertion on the line below was updated to formOrigin while the sentence above it was left. The field no longer exists, so the next reader greps for a symbol that is gone. code-review-standards.md #1 names exactly this sweep ('No place still describes the old behaviour. (Grep the old terms.)'). Out of scope: the .gogo/work/ archives and .gogo/skills/release-history/SKILL.md, which are historical records of 0.32.0/0.33.0 and correctly describe the field as it was then.

ROUND-2 VERIFICATION: re-grepped `pickerOrigin` across --include=*.go --include=*.md for the whole repo. Exactly one live hit remains, cli/internal/tui/model.go:402 ('It subsumes pickerOrigin, which itself replaced the pickerFromDrill bool...'), which is the deliberate lineage sentence describing the rename itself - correct to keep. Every other hit is in .gogo/work/ archives, .gogo/changelog/ or .gogo/skills/release-history/SKILL.md, all historical and correctly out of scope. Status -> verified.
issues.proposed_solution: AGENT-FIXABLE. Replace `pickerOrigin` with `formOrigin` in those four comments (session_ops_test.go:4 and :248, card_test.go:345, sessions_panel_test.go:206), then re-grep `--include=*.go --include=*.md` outside .gogo/work/ and .gogo/skills/release-history/ to confirm no live surface still names the field.
issues.fix_summary: The four stale pickerOrigin comments renamed to formOrigin (session_ops_test.go:4/:248, card_test.go:345, sessions_panel_test.go:206); re-grep clean outside .gogo/ archives and release-history. model.go:402 keeps its deliberate lineage mention (it describes the rename itself).

issues.title: Dead code touched by the diff: startForm (move.go:410-414) has no callers, yet the change reworked its signature instead of deleting it
issues.description:
cli/internal/tui/move.go:412 `func (m *Model) startForm(intent launch.Intent, isShip bool) tea.Cmd` is called from nowhere in cli/ (grepped the whole module; it was already unreferenced at HEAD, so this is pre-existing dead code). The diff nevertheless updated its signature and return statement to match the new startFormOverriding contract, which keeps a dead wrapper alive and makes it look load-bearing. Go's compiler does not flag an unused method, so nothing else will catch it. Minor/nit only - no behaviour rides on it.

ROUND-2 VERIFICATION: `func (m *Model) startForm` is gone and confirmContext is gone; grep for both across cli/ returns no declaration and no call. Swept for a NEW orphan by counting non-test and test references of every symbol this change added or reshaped (FastToken, HasFastParam, SetFastParam, FastParam, confirmSummary, confirmWhere, modalFormSize, overlayCenter, padToWidth, modalBoxStyle, enterLaunchModal, forcingNote, modalLaunchConfirm, launchConfirmed, viewTab, viewBehindForm): every one has at least one real call site beyond its declaration. Status -> verified. One residual: move.go:410's doc comment still opens 'startFormOverriding is startForm plus the FR3.3 override note', naming the symbol the fix deleted - folded into REV-007 rather than reopening this.
issues.proposed_solution: AGENT-FIXABLE. Delete startForm and its doc comment (cli/internal/tui/move.go:410-414); startFormOverriding is the only real entry point and already carries the documentation. Re-run gofmt/vet/test.
issues.fix_summary: Dead startForm deleted; also deleted confirmContext, which the REV-001 reshape had just orphaned (no new dead wrapper left behind).

issues.title: At (and just above) the modal's own advertised 60x12 minimum the height clamp still eats the form's ACTION ROW: with a real repo root the forced go Select renders ZERO options at 60x12, and the merged-ship modal loses its Launch/Cancel row entirely at 60x12-60x14
issues.description:
The REV-001 reshape moved the command out of the option labels and into the title - but the title is charged to the SAME row budget huh clamps (Group.WithHeight -> field.WithHeight -> Select.updateViewportHeight sets viewport.Height = height - title - description). modalFormSize hands huh h = termH - modalMarginH(2) - modalChromeH(2), so at the modal's own named minimum of 60x12 the form gets 8 rows while the wrapped title alone takes 4-5 of them. The variable round 1 never crossed is the REPO ROOT: confirmWhere appends '  at <root>', and this repo's own root is 37 characters.

Measured with go test -overlay against the real Model.View() (no product file touched), slug = this feature's 36-char slug, root = /Users/bartlomiej.zawadzki/repos/gogo:
  - go Select, UNFORCED: 'Cancel' is absent at 60x12 and 65x12. Everything at h >= 13, and everything at w >= 70, renders all three.
  - go Select, FORCED (M, with the compressed FORCING note): NO option at all renders at 60x12 and 65x12 (title + FORCING note + huh's help line, nothing else); 'Cancel' is absent at 70..85 x12, 60..80 x13 and 60..65 x14. From h >= 15 every width is clean.
  - merged-ship modal (release-name Input + Launch/Cancel Confirm), same root: the whole 'Launch     Cancel' row is ABSENT at 60x12 and at 60x14; present again at 70x14. This is the arm REV-002 option (a) deliberately kept inside the modal, and it is also exactly the failure the plan's own probe P1 warned about ('loses the Launch  Cancel row entirely'), arriving via the height clamp instead of WithWidth.
  - single-card ship confirm at 60x12: fine (its Launch/Cancel row renders).

Why it is a regression and not just 'a small terminal': at 59x12 - one column BELOW the minimum - the FR12 full-screen fallback renders the buttons, because an unsized form sizes its viewport to the rendered height. So 0.35.0 showed these rows at the same terminal size and 0.36.0 does not; the band exists only because modalMinTermW/H are set below the size the modal can actually honour. docs/cli-contract.md's new 0.36.0 note advertises the modal 'on a terminal at least 60x12', which is the claim this contradicts. FR11 is NOT affected - in every cell measured the composite is exactly termW wide and exactly termH tall, and the box's top and bottom borders are both present; this is clipped CONTENT, not overflow. code-review-standards.md #8 (a user-visible state must actually be rendered by View()).

Severity minor, not major: the band is ~60-85 columns by 12-14 rows, well under the sizes the cockpit is normally used at, and Enter still launches exactly the seeded/shown command (the title stays visible and correct throughout), so nothing launches unseen. Test gap that let it through: TestModalNeverExceedsTheTerminal's matrix stops at 80x20 and only measures width/height; TestGoSelectShowsAllThreeOptions starts at 80x24; TestForcedGoSelectShowsALaunchOptionAtTheModalMinimum is the only 60x12 case and uses a 4-char slug with the 6-char fixture root '/r/web', asserting merely that the string 'Launch' appears - so the root, the length that actually decides, is never varied anywhere in the suite.
issues.proposed_solution:
AGENT-FIXABLE. Pick one (a) or (b), then close the test gap either way.
(a) SIMPLEST - make the advertised minimum honest. Raise modalMinTermH from 12 to 15 (and consider modalMinTermW to 70) in cli/internal/tui/modal.go:22-23, so the whole measured band falls into the FR12 full-screen fallback, where huh sizes the option viewport to the RENDERED height and every option/button shows. One constant, one rule, and both producers (layout in enterLaunchModal/updateForm and render in View) already share modalFormSize, so they cannot disagree. Update the '60x12' figure in docs/cli-contract.md's 0.36.0 note, README.md and skills/gogo-cli/SKILL.md to whatever the new minimum is.
(b) SPEND FEWER ROWS ON THE TITLE. The command is what must be visible; the confirmWhere tail ('  in tmux session <name>  at <root>  · permission: auto (classifier)') is what costs 3-5 wrapped rows at 48-58 columns. Move that tail into the Select's Description (or drop it below ~90 columns) so the title is one or two lines at any modal width. Keep the command itself in the title through launch.SetFastParam so FR4's one-producer property is untouched.
TESTS (required either way): parameterise TestGoSelectShowsAllThreeOptions over the ROOT as well as the slug - add a ~37-char root - and extend its size matrix down through 70x14 / 65x13 / 60x12; strengthen TestForcedGoSelectShowsALaunchOptionAtTheModalMinimum to use the long slug + long root and to assert ALL THREE options (or, under (a), to assert the byte-for-byte full-screen fallback at that size); and add a merged-ship case asserting the 'Launch' and 'Cancel' strings are present at the modal minimum.
issues.fix_summary:
modalMinTermH raised 12 -> 15 (the measured floor: every cell the reviewer probed with a real-length root renders all options at >=15; below it the FR12 full-screen fallback shows them, as 0.35.0 did). Docs updated (cli-contract 0.36.0 note, gogo-cli skill). Tests now vary the ROOT: TestGoSelectShowsAllThreeOptions uses a 43-char root and adds 70x15 + 60x15 cells; the forced-minimum test runs at the named minimum consts with the long root, plus a one-row-below subtest asserting the byte-for-byte fallback shows all three options.

TEST-ROUND-1 INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION (real tmux drive, real terminal, the built 0.36.0 binary - not go test -overlay): reproduced against a FRESH fixture the reviewer never used - slug 'add-dark-mode-toggle-to-settings-panel' (38 chars) and root '/Users/bartlomiej.zawadzki/gg-e2e-fixture-repo' (46 chars) - to check the fix generalises rather than just fitting the reviewer's own probe values. go Select UNFORCED at exactly 60x15: all three options visible ('> Launch', 'Launch --fast  (token-lean gogo-fast)', 'Cancel'), title shows the live command. At 60x14 (one row below): falls back to the byte-for-byte full-screen form, still showing all three options (unsized viewport sizes to rendered height, matching 0.35.0). go Select FORCED (M, with a real cap=1 fastMode:true source + a live gogo-go-busy-build session so the FORCING note actually renders): at 60x15 the seeded 'Launch --fast' option is visible with the FORCING note intact, and pressing 'j' scrolls the viewport to reveal 'Cancel' (reachable, not a dead end - matches this issue's own documented acceptable degradation for the forced arm). At 60x14 the full-screen fallback shows the FORCING note plus all three options. Single-card ship confirm modal at 200x50/120x30/80x24: renders fine. Verdict: the NAMED defect (go Select, unforced and forced, at/around the 60x15 minimum) is fixed and holds under an independently-varied slug/root. Status -> verified.

One ADJACENT gap found during this same pass, filed separately (not blocking this verification): the MERGED-ship modal (2+ ready cards selected, d) opens with focus on the release-name Input, so at exactly 60x15 the Launch/Cancel row is scrolled out of view until the user presses Enter/Tab once (the group's focus-follow scrolling then reveals it) - reachable via the hint bar's own 'enter next', so not a dead end, but not 'renders all options' on first paint either, and TestModalNeverExceedsTheTerminal's 'merged ship' case never includes 60x15 or asserts Launch/Cancel text presence (only the FR11 bound). See TEST-001.

issues.title: Six prose surfaces (three of them shipped user docs) plus the as-built chart still say each launch option's LABEL carries the exact command - the REV-001 fix moved it to the title - and move.go:410 still names the deleted startForm
issues.description:
The REV-001 fix changed the option labels to one-liners ('Launch' / 'Launch --fast  (token-lean gogo-fast)' / 'Cancel') and put the exact command in the Select's TITLE, but the prose describing that shape was not swept with it. code-review-standards.md #1 is exactly this check ('No place still describes the old behaviour. (Grep the old terms.)') and it is the same class as REV-004, which this very round fixed.

Stale sites, all verified by grep against the current tree:
  - README.md:469 - 'seeded from the source's fastMode config with each option showing the exact command it runs'
  - docs/cli-contract.md:396 - 'each launch option's label carrying the exact command it runs' (inside the new 0.36.0 contract note - the most load-bearing of the three)
  - skills/gogo-cli/SKILL.md:87 - 'each launch option showing the exact command it runs'
  - cli/internal/tui/move.go:418 - startFormOverriding's OWN doc comment says 'each launch option's label carrying the EXACT command it runs', and is contradicted 45 lines below by the in-body comment at move.go:462-466 that correctly says 'The EXACT command lives in the TITLE instead'. A function whose header contradicts its body is the worst of the six.
  - cli/internal/tui/launch_modal_test.go:17 and :59 - the file header ('each launch option's label') and TestLaunchConfirmSeedsFastFromSource's doc line ('BOTH launch options' labels carry their exact commands (D1=B discoverability)'), the latter contradicted by its own body comment at :70.
  - .gogo/work/feature-launch-confirm-modal-and-fast-toggle/charts/flow.mmd, the `sel` node - 'labels carry SetFastParam(cmd,false) / SetFastParam(cmd,true)'. This is the AS-BUILT chart, so it is meant to describe what shipped, and it describes the round-1 shape.
Separately, cli/internal/tui/move.go:410 opens 'startFormOverriding is startForm plus the FR3.3 override note' - `startForm` was deleted by the REV-005 fix, so the sentence defines the function in terms of a symbol a reader cannot find.

Docs-only, no behaviour rides on it - but three of the sites are user-facing (README, the CLI contract, the gogo-cli skill), and the contract note is the file a headless consumer is told to trust.
issues.proposed_solution: AGENT-FIXABLE. One wording, applied at all six prose sites: the two launch options are ONE-LINE labels ('Launch' / 'Launch --fast'), and the exact command lives in the confirm's TITLE, updating live as the selection moves. Concretely: README.md:469, docs/cli-contract.md:396 and skills/gogo-cli/SKILL.md:87 -> replace '...each launch option('s label)? (showing|carrying) the exact command it runs' with '...the confirm's title showing the exact command the highlighted option will run, updated live as you move between them'; cli/internal/tui/move.go:418 -> align the header with the in-body comment at :462-466; cli/internal/tui/launch_modal_test.go:17 and :59 -> same; redraw the `sel` node in charts/flow.mmd as 'one-line labels; TitleFunc(SetFastParam(cmd, mode == launch-fast)) re-evaluated on the bound launchMode'. Also drop the dangling `startForm` reference from move.go:410 (e.g. 'startFormOverriding opens the board launch confirm; the FR3.3 override note ...'). Then re-grep --include='*.go' --include='*.md' for "option's label", 'option showing the exact', 'labels carry' and '\bstartForm\b' outside .gogo/changelog/ and the .gogo/work/ archives to confirm the sweep is complete.
issues.fix_summary:
All six prose surfaces updated to the title-carries-the-command shape (README, cli-contract, gogo-cli SKILL, move.go startFormOverriding doc - which also lost its dangling startForm reference, launch_modal_test.go header + seeds comment) and the as-built charts/flow.mmd sel node redrawn (layouts.json regenerated).

TEST-ROUND-1 INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION: re-grepped the whole repo (excluding .gogo/work/ archives and .gogo/changelog/, which are historical) for "option's label", "option showing the exact", "labels carry" and the bare \bstartForm\b symbol - zero live hits. Spot-checked all six named sites directly: README.md:469 now reads '...exact command it will run shown in the confirm's title and updated live...'; docs/cli-contract.md's 0.36.0 note states the modal renders 'on a terminal at least 60x15' (consistent with REV-006's fix) and 'the exact command it will run shown in the confirm's TITLE... re-evaluated live'; skills/gogo-cli/SKILL.md:87 matches; cli/internal/tui/move.go's startFormOverriding doc comment (:410-422) no longer mentions startForm and correctly says the exact command lives in the TITLE, consistent with its own body. Status -> verified.
